evidence.reason: At line 656, `prepare_run` selects the SSH forwarding port with `free_port()` and persists it in the run record. `free_port()` is only an availability probe, not a reservation, so two prepared runs can be assigned the same port; by boot time that saved port may already be bound, and boot reuses the saved value. Selecting the port under the boot/run lock with a bounded bind retry is a minimal correctness fix for this race.
